Rahmania Commercial Centres
MIXED-USE INFRASTRUCTURE
Delivery of the complete secondary works package for two commercial centres, completed in 2025 within the 2,500-home residential development in Douira.
Two commercial centres in Douira's 2,500-home programme, fitted out to host the district's shops and everyday services.

SARL Igloo Yapi Construction executed the complete secondary works package (corps d'état secondaires - CES) for both commercial structures. The scope of work transformed the raw reinforced concrete frames into fully fitted, functional retail environments designed to accommodate local merchants and public services.

The building envelopes feature extensive glazed curtain walling integrated with decorative architectural screens. Internally, vertical circulation is anchored by a central staircase, while a structural pyramid glass skylight provides natural daylighting across the retail floor plates.
Completed in 2025, the project was delivered on schedule, with all secondary trades coordinated to meet modern commercial building standards.
